# Fetch content for all notes and parse habit data
import json

habit_data = []  # list of dicts: {date, habits: {habit: yes/no}}
for note in all_notes:
    content = apis.simple_note.show_note(access_token=access_token, note_id=note['note_id'])
    # Extract date from title: "Habit Tracking Log for YYYY-MM-DD"
    title = content['title']
    date_str = title.split(' for ')[-1].strip()
    # Parse content lines after the header
    lines = content['content'].split('\n')
    habits = {}
    for line in lines:
        line = line.strip()
        if ':' in line and not line.startswith('#'):
            parts = line.split(':', 1)
            habit_name = parts[0].strip()
            value = parts[1].strip().lower()
            if value in ('yes', 'no'):
                habits[habit_name] = value
    habit_data.append({'date': date_str, 'habits': habits})

# Print first few to verify
print(len(habit_data))
print(habit_data[0])
print(habit_data[-1])
